entries.title: The builder’s guide to GPT‑5.6
entries.summary: Learn how startups use GPT-5.6 to build faster, more cost-efficient AI agents with smarter model selection and new Responses API capabilities.

entries.title: Previewing Ultrafast mode: GPT-5.6 Sol at up to 14X the speed
entries.summary: Preview Ultrafast, a new OpenAI API service tier that runs GPT-5.6 Sol up to 14× faster. Powered by Cerebras, it delivers up to 750 output tokens per second.

entries.title: OpenAI appoints Dali Rajic as Chief Revenue Officer
entries.summary: OpenAI appoints Dali Rajic as Chief Revenue Officer to lead its global revenue organization and help businesses realize the full value of AI.

entries.title: From assistance to execution: How enterprises put AI to work
entries.summary: OpenAI research reveals how enterprises are adopting agentic AI, using ChatGPT and Codex, and how frontier firms are pulling ahead in AI adoption.

entries.title: How RingCentral builds AI-native work from engineering to ops
entries.summary: See how RingCentral uses ChatGPT Work and Codex to accelerate AI product development and centralize operational intelligence across engineering and operations.

entries.title: Testing ads in ChatGPT
entries.summary: OpenAI begins testing ads in ChatGPT to support free access, with clear labeling, answer independence, strong privacy protections, and user control.

entries.title: Daybreak models are now available on AWS
entries.summary: OpenAI and AWS are making Daybreak cybersecurity capabilities available through Amazon Bedrock to support enterprise security workflows.

entries.title: OpenAI’s letter to Governor Abbott on responsible AI infrastructure in Texas
entries.summary: OpenAI sent Governor Greg Abbott a letter outlining its commitment to responsible AI infrastructure in Texas. The letter supports reliable, transparent growth that benefits Texans.

entries.title: Model ML completes finance work more efficiently with GPT-5.6 Sol
entries.summary: Model ML uses GPT-5.6 Sol to carry finance work from research and analysis through editable, traceable PowerPoint decks and Excel workbooks.

entries.title: What building an AI-native finance function taught me
entries.summary: OpenAI CFO Sarah Friar shares five lessons for building an AI-native finance function, from automated forecasting to stronger controls and AI ROI.
